source: A 60 s bridge period matches the OTel SDK's default metric export interval and the store's 60 s Prometheus scrape interval, and sits under monitor_staleness_seconds_max.

rows.name: monitor_bridge_period_seconds
rows.source: OpenTelemetry SDK environment variables, Periodic exporting MetricReader: OTEL_METRIC_EXPORT_INTERVAL default 60000 ms (https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/otel/configuration/sdk-environment-variables/, read 2026-11-10); under monitor_staleness_seconds_max=900 in deploy/monitor/l7/parameters.json.
